arxiv-2202-04472.title: Images of magnetospheric reconnection-powered radiation around supermassive black holes
arxiv-2202-04472.creator: Benjamin Crinquand, Benoît Cerutti, Guillaume Dubus, Kyle Parfrey, Alexander Philippov
arxiv-2202-04472.description: Abstract Accreting supermassive black holes can now be observed at the event-horizon scale at millimeter wavelengths. Current predictions for the image rely on hypotheses (fluid modeling, thermal electrons) which might not always hold in the vicinity of the black hole, so that a full kinetic treatment is in order.

arxiv-2210-04943.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Cristian Vay. The copointed liftings of the Fomin-Kirillov algebra ℱ ​ 𝒦 3 \mathcal{FK}_{3} over the algebra of functions on the symmetric group 𝕊 3 \mathbb{S}_{3} were classified by Andruskiewitsch and the author. arxiv-2404-15081.title: Perturbing Attention Gives You More Bang for the Buck: Subtle Imaging Perturbations That Efficiently Fool Customized Diffusion Models
arxiv-2404-15081.creator: Jingyao Xu, Siyang Lu, Yuetong Lu, Dongdong Wang, Yandong Li, Xiang Wei
arxiv-2404-15081.description: Abstract Diffusion models (DMs) embark a new era of generative modeling and offer more opportunities for efficient generating high-quality and realistic data samples. However, their widespread use has also brought forth new challenges in model security, which motivates the creation of more effective adversarial attackers on DMs to understand its vulnerability.

arxiv-2408-02078.title: LDFaceNet : Latent Diffusion-based Network for High-Fidelity Deepfake Generation
arxiv-2408-02078.creator: Dwij Mehta *, Aditya Mehta *, Pratik Narang
arxiv-2408-02078.description: Abstract Over the past decade, there has been tremendous progress in the domain of synthetic media generation. This is mainly due to the powerful methods based on generative adversarial networks (GANs). Very recently, diffusion probabilistic models, which are inspired by non-equilibrium thermodynamics, have taken the spotlight.

arxiv-2601-03122.title: Late-time Background Constraints on Linear and Non-linear Interacting Dark Energy after DESI DR2
arxiv-2601-03122.creator: David Figueruelo, Marcel van der Westhuizen, Amare Abebe, Eleonora Di Valentino
arxiv-2601-03122.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by David Figueruelo, Marcel van der Westhuizen, Amare Abebe, Eleonora Di Valentino. In this study, we present observational constraints on a class of phenomenological interacting dark energy (IDE) models that admit analytical solutions for the Hubble parameter H ⁡ ( z ) H(z) . We consider a set of five linear and three non-linear IDE scenarios, encompassing both interactions proportional to the dark matter and/or dark energy densities, as well as non-linear combinations of the two.

pmc-10596735.creator: Organised by: Robert Koch Institute (Germany), Sciensano (Belgium), Santé Publique France (France), Chair persons: Elvira Mauz (Germany), Julia Thom (Germany)
pmc-10596735.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). To meet the information needs arising from the COVID-19 pandemic, public health institutes and agencies in several countries began to monitor the mental health of populations at a higher frequency. Quarterly, monthly, weekly, or even daily data on key indicators are being used to inform governments, practitioners, and members of the public of mental health developments taking place in the context of multiple dynamic and ongoing crises.

pmc-10867857.creator: Thiago S Guimaraes, Marilia FV Marceliano-Alves, José C Provenzano, Patricia P Olivares, Ana GS Limoeiro, Flavio RF Alves, Luciana A Dias

pmc-11518691.title: The Dopamine Transporter Is a New Target for Ischemic Stroke
pmc-11518691.creator: Yan‐Qiong Cheng, Ruo‐Xi Zhang, Xing‐Yuan Li, Xiao‐Ting Zhou, Ming Chen, Ai‐Jun Liu
pmc-11518691.description: AimsDopamine transporter (DAT) can regulate DA homeostasis and has been implicated in many nervous system diseases. Whether DAT is involved in the protection against ischemic stroke is unclear.MethodsIn vivo microdialysis measurements of DA were recorded in the ischemic penumbral area of mice with middle cerebral artery occlusion (MCAO). DAT coding gene, Slc6a3 mutation, and DAT overexpression animals were performed MCAO.

pmc-11613857.title: Experimental evolution reveals evolutionary bias and its causes
pmc-11613857.creator: Haoyuan Wu, Yonghua Wu
pmc-11613857.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundSpecies generally exhibits evolutionary bias, adapting towards a specific direction rather than others, yet the underlying causes remains unknown.ResultsHere, we investigated evolutionary bias and its causes by conducting experimental evolution on Escherichia coli. coli strain (lac-), initially unable to utilize lactose due to a frameshift mutation, into two different culture media: one medium (L) containing ample sodium acetate and lactose as carbon sources, and the other medium (G) containing abundant glucose and lactose as carbon sources.

pmc-11860039.title: Comparing IM Lorazepam and IM Clothiapine for Agitated Psychosis in Hospitalized Patients
pmc-11860039.creator: • Kverashvili, E Malik, • Shelef, • Stryjer
pmc-11860039.description: IntroductionWhen patients in a closed hospital ward experience acute psychosis and become highly agitated or pose a risk to themselves and others, it’s often crucial to provide immediate sedative treatment. However, there is currently no consensus on whether the preferred medication for these situations should be antipsychotic drugs or benzodiazepines.

pmc-12469729.title: In Silico and In Vitro Studies of Anti-Inflammatory, Anti-Oxidative Stress, and Anti-Apoptosis Effect of 7-Octenoic Acid Derived from Moringa oleifera Lam., on LPS-Induced Monocyte-Derived Macrophages (MDM)
pmc-12469729.creator: Kittipong Srimuang, Watunyoo Buakaew, Yordhathai Thongsri, Krai Daowtak, Pachuen Potup, Antonio Ferrante, Kanchana Usuwanthim
pmc-12469729.description: While Moringa oleifera Lam. (MO) extracts are known to have various bioactive properties, including anti-inflammatory properties, the components responsible still remain to be identified. This study explores the protective effects of the MO component, 7-octenoic acid (7OCT) in LPS-stimulated THP-1 macrophage inflammatory responses.

pmc-12691386.title: Bacteroides fragilis Promotes Mesenchymal Subtype in Colorectal Cancer
pmc-12691386.creator: Shin Young Chang, Jihye Park, Soo Jung Park, Jae Jun Park, Jae Hee Cheon, Dong Keon Kim, Tae Il Kim, Alain P Gobert
pmc-12691386.description: Simple SummaryColorectal cancer (CRC) is a heterogeneous disease with an aggressive stromal subtype, CMS4, that relies on the tumor microenvironment (TME) for progression and malignancy. The microbiome is a key component of the TME; however, its role in determining CRC subtypes remains unclear.

pmc-12757259.title: Methylprednisolone pulse versus docetaxel in recurrent thymoma with myasthenia gravis
pmc-12757259.creator: Hongxia Yang, Yaxuan Wang, Zulin Pan, Ze Liu, Biqi Cheng, Guoyan Qi
pmc-12757259.description: IntroductionThis study aims to compare the effectiveness and safety of methylprednisolone pulse versus docetaxel in treating recurrent thymoma with myasthenia gravis (MG).MethodsWe conducted a single-center, open-label, retrospective study that included 90 patients with thymoma recurrence accompanied by MG, who were treated with either methylprednisolone pulse or docetaxel.

pmc-13157106.title: The intrinsic disorder challenge for AlphaFold: A case study of G3BP1 and pathogenic peptide
pmc-13157106.creator: Yucong Li, Zhiying Yao, Zilin Song, Peiguo Yang, Jing Huang, Kai Lei, You Xu
pmc-13157106.description: SummaryThe dipeptide repeat protein GR20 in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) exerts neurotoxicity in part by binding to the stress granule protein G3BP1 and disrupting liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS). However, the structural basis of this interaction remains elusive due to the pervasive intrinsic disorder in both partners. Here, we combine biochemical assays and structure prediction to characterize the G3BP1-GR20 complex.

pmc-13354660.title: MiR-4327 targets TP53 to promote cervical cancer cell proliferation
pmc-13354660.creator: Mei-Lin Chen, Chen-Yang Chu, Feng-Xian Zhang, Li-Pei Zhang, Ying Yang, Bai-Zhao Peng, Chuang-Hai Wu, Xiao-Mei Chen, Yan-Ting You, Bing-Ying Rong, Hiu Yee Kwan, Xiao-Shan Zhao, Yan-Yan Liu
pmc-13354660.description: Cervical cancer is a leading cause of female malignancy worldwide. While microRNA-4327 (miR-4327) has been implicated as a potential oncogene, its functional role and molecular mechanisms in cervical cancer pathogenesis remain unclear. This study aimed to determine the oncogenic function of miR-4327 and elucidate its downstream regulatory mechanism in cervical cancer pathogenesis.

pmc-13360094.title: A Nomogram Integrating Clinical and Ultrasonographic Features for Preoperative Differentiation of Invasive Ductal Carcinoma and Invasive Lobular Carcinoma of the Breast
pmc-13360094.creator: Deqing Zhang, Yuqing Zhang, Yan Li

pmc-13471196.title: Protocol for detecting protein recruitment to clathrin structures in cultured cells
pmc-13471196.creator: Laura A. Orofiamma, Costin N. Antonescu
pmc-13471196.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SummaryClathrin-mediated endocytosis internalizes key cell-surface receptors and relies on coordinated recruitment of adaptors and accessory proteins to clathrin structures. Here, we present a protocol for quantifying protein recruitment to diffraction-limited clathrin structures at the plasma membrane. We describe steps for the inducible expression of tagged proteins, total internal reflection fluorescence (TIRF) microscopy, the analysis of proteins within clathrin structures, UltraID-based proximity-labeling, and western blotting detection of proteins in clathrin structures.

pmc-13545149.title: Evaluation of the Community Urgent Eyecare Service in Greater Manchester, Including the Impact of Independent Prescribing
pmc-13545149.creator: Aoife L. Y. Quah, Amy Hughes, Wendy Craven, Helen Wilson, Emma Williams, Felipe Dhawahir-Scala, Patrick J. G. Gunn, Robert A. Harper
pmc-13545149.description: PurposeCommunity Urgent Eyecare Services (CUES) utilises primary care optometrists to reduce urgent eyecare demand within ophthalmology and general practice (GP). This large-scale study evaluated CUES in Greater Manchester (GM), including assessing the embedded Independent Prescribing (IP) pathway.MethodsThis retrospective, GM-wide analysis evaluated CUES data from 1st January to 31st December 2024.

pmc-13689034.title: Nurses’ experiences with assessing pain in patients with dementia in nursing homes: a qualitative study
pmc-13689034.creator: Arlén Akselberg, Oda Dyrnes Schei, Stine Hauvik
pmc-13689034.description: BackgroundApproximately 80% of long-term care residents in Norwegian nursing homes have dementia. Patients with dementia represent a vulnerable group that tends to underreport pain, mainly due to difficulty expressing pain. Nurses are responsible for assessing pain in patients with dementia when signs of discomfort are evident through behavioural changes.
